Subject: Governance board read-only access request for SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Aditya,

Quick one from our side — our Governance & Risk committee needs read-only access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II artifacts for an internal review ahead of our procurement approval. The committee will review: the SOC 2 report, the associated bridge letter (if available), and the evidence bundle for the 2025 audit period.

A few specifics we need clarified before we request formal access:
- Exact audit period covered by the SOC 2 Type II report (start / end dates).
- Whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter stating there have been no material changes since the report period ended.
- Preferred access method for the committee: temporary trust portal invite for a small list of read-only users, or a one-time download (ZIP) of the evidence manifest.

I've attached our completed SOC2_Access_Form.pdf with the committee member emails. Can you advise on your standard onboarding window (how long the temporary invite stays valid) and if you support per-user MFA for auditors?

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Grant
Director, Governance & Risk
FinTechCo

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance board read-only access request for SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Oliver — thanks for the form and the clear asks. We can absolutely support the Governance & Risk committee review. Answers inline below and next steps at the end.

- Audit period: our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter confirming no material changes since 2025-06-30. We usually provide a short technical addendum if there are minor infra changes; if you prefer, I can share a draft for your counsel to review.
- Access options: we support both approaches. Our recommended path is read-only Trust Portal invites (per-user accounts with scoped permission). Portal invites are short-lived by default (7 days token validity) but we can extend to 14 days for auditor onboarding. We also provide a CSV manifest of the evidence bundle; we avoid shipping a single ZIP by default for security reasons, but we can provide a one-time signed delivery upon request.

MFA: yes, portal accounts use standard SSO + optional per-user TOTP (we can enable enforced MFA for the auditor accounts if required).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the exact list of committee emails and which mode you prefer (portal invites vs one-time bundle).
2) If portal invites, indicate desired expiry window (7 or 14 days).
3) If you want the bridge letter draft, I'll attach and share an editable doc for counsel.

I've attached our SOC2_sharing_policy.pdf which outlines retention, logging, and download controls. Monica (copied) will own provisioning once we confirm the list.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_sharing_policy.pdf

- One-time ZIP: if you later request a ZIP, please confirm in reply and we'll coordinate a signed SFTP/secure transfer window. We prefer portal-first for auditability.

I'll mark this thread as provisioning in progress. Monica, can you confirm when the invites are sent and paste the portal invite link here once live?

Thanks — aditya
